warnings: **Genuine spec conflict between the footing-detail pedestal (S-06/S-07 sections) and the column schedule's 'เสาตอม่อ' row (S-07 ตารางเสา)** — S-06's sections 3-3/5-5/8-8 and S-07's section 10-10 each show the pedestal (เสาตอม่อ) as a 0.30x0.30 m shaft with Ø9mm main bars (4+4 for F3, 6+6 for F5/F8/F10) rising not less than 1.00 m from the footing to ±0.00; S-07's ตารางเสา (column schedule table) separately shows a 'เสาตอม่อ' row for both C1 and C2 at 0.25x0.25 m with 4-Ø16mm bars, ties Ø6mm@0.10 — a different size AND a different rebar spec for what is nominally the same physical member. Resolved per the project's section-wins-over-schedule precedence: the footing-section pedestal spec (0.30x0.30, Ø9mm, per-footing bar count) is used as this house's 'pedestal' element spec below; the column table's conflicting 'เสาตอม่อ' row is recorded but NOT used, flagged 'spec_conflict_section_vs_schedule'.

F10's exact pile arrangement (10 piles) could not be resolved with full confidence from the S-07 plan-view dot pattern — the pad's overall 1.65x1.65 m size and the '10' pile count (matching the mark name F10 and the section label '10-10', the same naming convention confirmed for F3=3 piles/F5=5 piles/F8=8 piles) are recorded with high confidence, but the internal pile grid spacing is approximate.

Footing pad mat rebar (Ø12mm, two-way, count growing 4+4/6+6/8+8/10+10 for F3/F5/F8/F10) and pedestal shaft rebar (Ø9mm, 4+4/6+6/6+6/6+6) are two distinct rebar callouts on the same section drawing, correctly kept separate as `rebar` (pad) vs the pedestal element's `main_bar` (shaft) — not merged.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'footing_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 5 footing-family elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
